title: 什么是生物安全柜？
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/04_What are Biosafety cabinets , biosafety cabinet in microbiology laboratory biosa.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/04_What are Biosafety cabinets , biosafety cabinet in microbiology laboratory biosa/src.py

points.K1: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
points.K5: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
points.K7: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
points.K9: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
points.K13: 三级柜：手套口和传递气锁
points.K14: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台生物安全柜旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课专讲生物安全柜。
overlay: 生物安全柜的三个级别

shots.scene: 一、二、三级三台柜子图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons in a row: an open-front cabinet, a cabinet with a front window, and a sealed glove-box style cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 它分一、二、三级，各不相同。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着实验室里两台外形不同的安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at two different biological safety cabinets in the lab, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现，实验室里的安全柜不一样。

shots.scene: 阿杰问小研，小研笑着拿出空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks a question; the female graduate student smiles and takes out a blank cabinet manual.
shots.narration: 小研说：级别不同，护的东西也不同。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
shots.scene: 生物安全柜正面，前窗半开
shots.prompt_en: Front view of a biological safety cabinet with its window at the marked height and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，是一种生物防护设备。
overlay: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：护人、护环境、护样品
shots.scene: 三个盾牌：人、地球、样品管
shots.prompt_en: Three shields protecting a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它保护人员、环境，还有样品。

shots.scene: 三台柜子按密闭程度从开放到全封闭排列
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons arranged from fully open front to fully sealed. No people.
shots.narration: 按提供的防护水平，分成三级。

shots.scene: 一级柜：前面敞开
shots.prompt_en: A simple class one cabinet with an open front, beside a lab coat, gloves and goggles icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先看一级柜。

shots.scene: 盾牌挡在人形图标前和地球图标前
shots.prompt_en: Shields in front of a person outline and a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它保护使用者和环境，免受有害材料伤害。

shots.scene: 柜内样品旁飘进室内的灰尘点
shots.prompt_en: Dust dots from room air drift into the cabinet and land near an open culture dish. No people.
shots.narration: 但它不保护操作的材料，

shots.scene: 样品管图标上出现污染点，旁边一个叉
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube icon with contamination dots and a red X beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 材料可能被污染。

shots.section_title: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
shots.scene: 剖面图：空气从前面开口被吸进柜内
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a class one cabinet: room air flows in through the open front, away from the user. No people.
shots.narration: 一级柜前面敞开，把空气从人这边吸走，
overlay: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风

shots.section_title: 一级柜：前面敞开，向里吸风
shots.scene: 空气经过顶部过滤器后排出
shots.prompt_en: The air passes through a filter at the top before being exhausted. No people.
shots.narration: 经过过滤后再排出去。

shots.scene: 风险刻度上低到中段被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A risk scale from low to high with the low-to-middle section highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 一级柜一般用于低到中度风险的因子。

shots.scene: 挥发性试剂瓶和放射标志旁打叉
shots.prompt_en: A volatile chemical bottle and a radiation warning sign, each with a red X beside a class one cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 它不适合挥发性化学品和放射性核素。

shots.section_title: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
shots.scene: 二级柜特写，前窗有标记线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a class two biological safety cabinet with a front window at a marked height. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜是最常用的安全柜。
overlay: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护

shots.section_title: 二级柜：最常用，三方面都护
shots.scene: 三个盾牌同时亮起
shots.prompt_en: Shields over a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon light up together. No people.
shots.narration: 使用者、环境、样品，它都能保护。

shots.scene: 三台二级柜图标，排风箭头各不相同
shots.prompt_en: Three class two cabinet icons with different exhaust arrows: some return air to the room, one ducted to the roof. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜有三个防护等级：

shots.scene: 气流方向、排风管、盾牌三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: airflow arrows, an exhaust duct going outside, and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 按气流、排风系统和防护水平来分。

shots.section_title: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
shots.scene: 剖面图：过滤后的空气从上往下吹
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a class two cabinet: filtered air flows down over the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜把高效过滤和气流结合起来，
overlay: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌

shots.section_title: 二级柜：过滤加气流，保持无菌
shots.scene: 小研在二级柜里操作培养物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, works with cultures in a class two cabinet.
shots.narration: 提供一个无菌的工作环境。

shots.scene: 风险刻度中到高段被点亮
shots.prompt_en: A risk scale with the middle-to-high section highlighted next to a class two cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜适用于中到高风险的因子。

shots.scene: 三级柜：全封闭的手套箱式柜
shots.prompt_en: A fully sealed glove-box style class three cabinet with two glove ports. No people.
shots.narration: 三级柜是最安全的一种，

shots.scene: 三个盾牌最大最亮
shots.prompt_en: Large glowing shields over a person icon, a globe icon and a sample tube icon. No people.
shots.narration: 对人、环境和样品，防护都最高。

shots.scene: 柜子被一圈厚墙完全包围
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the sealed cabinet surrounded by a thick wall, no air arrows escaping. No people.
shots.narration: 它用于最危险的生物因子，

shots.scene: 柜内和柜外之间一道实线分隔
shots.prompt_en: A solid line separating inside the cabinet from the room outside. No people.
shots.narration: 与外界环境完全隔离。

shots.section_title: 三级柜：手套口和传递气锁
shots.scene: 柜子嵌在实验室墙体中的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of the sealed cabinet built into the wall of a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 三级柜通常嵌在实验室里建造。
overlay: 三级柜：手套口和传递气锁

shots.section_title: 三级柜：手套口和传递气锁
shots.scene: 手伸进手套口的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of hands inserted into the glove ports of a sealed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 操作时，手伸进手套口，

shots.section_title: 三级柜：手套口和传递气锁
shots.scene: 侧面传递气锁，一道门关、一道门开
shots.prompt_en: A pass-through airlock box on the side of the cabinet with two doors, one closed while the other opens. No people.
shots.narration: 物品经传递气锁进出工作区。

shots.section_title: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜
shots.scene: 废物袋在柜内封好，再进入灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A sealed waste bag inside the cabinet moving into an attached autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里的所有材料和废物，
overlay: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜

shots.section_title: 三级柜：废物处理后才出柜
shots.scene: 处理后的废物从柜子另一侧出来，绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Treated waste comes out the other side with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 都要在柜内封装处理后才能移出。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁三台柜子图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three cabinet icons that light up one by one.
shots.narration: 一级护人和环境，不护样品；

shots.scene: 二级柜和三个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A class two cabinet icon with three shields. No people.
shots.narration: 二级最常用，三方面都护；

shots.scene: 三级柜和手套口
shots.prompt_en: A sealed class three cabinet icon with glove ports. No people.
shots.narration: 三级完全隔离，防护最高。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在二级柜前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye in front of a class two biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 认清级别再使用，下次见！
